# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 33 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 37 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_033_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 33

**1** Jesus said: "What you hear with your ear, preach from your rooftops.

**2** For no one lights a lamp and puts it under a bushel [хоуіт] or in a hidden place, but rather sets it on a lampstand [лухніа] so that everyone who comes in and goes out will see its light."

---

**Textual Notes (EMET):**
- "Hear with one ear" — P.Oxy 1 lines 30-35 has "hear in your one ear," distinguishing hearing types; the Coptic has "with your ear"
- *хоуіт*: bushel, basket; a measuring vessel used to cover a lamp
- *лухніа*: lampstand; Greek loan-word λυχνία
- cf. Matt 5:15; Luke 8:16; 11:33 — the lamp/lampstand saying; widely distributed in Q and Luke
- Thomas combines the sayings: preach what you hear (v.1) + lamp on stand (v.2)
- P.Oxy 1 lines 30-35 for Greek parallel
